chapter: Early drum sets and dance-hall era
title: Dances, waltzes and old dance forms
summary: He explains that balls had waltzes and 2/4 music and that he sneaked into the halls as a kid.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: People like, by the way, people like Faiso when you were starting out, before you started out, what sort of rhythm did they play? You said they played waltzes on the street floor?

No, that was in the dance hall. Mm-hmm. You know, dances or balls they used to call them during that time. They didn't call them a dance like they called them, they called them a ball during that time. You go to a ball. And little organizations had banquets on Mondays like that. What they used to call them, they used to call them bonquets during that time. Mm-hmm. Well, see that was a time that the kids could go into those places, but those balls at night, you weren't aligned in no ball. Mm-hmm. The only thing, the only way I was aligned there, like I tell you, I'd sneak in carrying the guys drunk and get upstairs where the orchestra hadn't stayed there. Mm-hmm. And if they knew I was in there, they'd put me out, see.
But I'd sneak in and get up there and hide.
But they didn't play all waltzes.

What else did they play? Oh, no, no, they play a lot of them. That's why I know so many of these old numbers like them, playing with these guys now. Mm-hmm. They're from remembrance, good remembrance. And, you know, the licks are on the drums for them old numbers. A lot of them old numbers I used to hear those guys playing.
Well, did they play all 2-4, 4-4 other than waltzes or what?
Well, most of them, the waltzes was a 2-4. Mm-hmm. Yeah, 2-4 at the time. That's it. Mm-hmm.
Did you ever hear anybody play a quadru?
Well, I heard them during the time, I didn't know what they were. Yeah. Didn't know what it was.
That's just about died out, I guess, by the time you were sneaking in to the house.
Yeah. I might have heard them, didn't know what it was, what they were playing. Mm-hmm.
Well, they had all kind of dances years ago. I never saw them, but I have seen the quadru once and that was all.
